phases.name: Setup & guardrails
phases.note: Repo is runnable from a clean clone as of the README/requirements/CI work; consent + pseudonym handling still outstanding before any non-team testing.

phases.name: Diverse board + eval pipeline
phases.note: 120-turn scored run. Diverse boards span the space; see mac/evaluation/phase1/PHASE1_REPORT.md.

phases.name: Console + device simulator
phases.note: Console serves boards and runs the VLM on a dropped image. /api/console/transcribe exists; the record button is markup only — MediaRecorder not wired.

phases.name: Self-test harness + metric reframe
phases.note: 120 scenarios, one command, JSONL + plots. Caught a real taxonomy bug.

phases.name: Knowledge distillation
phases.note: Corpus regenerated (600 boards) and committed. v2 retrained and reproducible. v3 open-vocabulary bi-encoder added: wins the diversity gates under 5-fold CV (distinct-functions +0.69 [+0.61,+0.76], same-function-pair +0.021 [+0.013,+0.029]) but its coverage margin is -0.0397, so v2 stays the default. Gates now carry bootstrap CIs and report INCONCLUSIVE where they cannot resolve.

phases.name: Intel / OpenVINO readiness
phases.note: OpenVINO IRs rebuilt against the retrained student with .vocab.sha sidecars committed; VOICELINK_STUDENT_BACKEND=openvino verified to load and serve a board end-to-end. Per-tower INT8/INT4 quantization Pareto measured (int4/int4 = 197 KB, 5.5x smaller, 0.922 board overlap; INT4 beats INT8 on size, accuracy AND latency). Intel-hardware numbers still pending — all measurements are Apple Silicon via the ARM CPU plugin.

phases.name: Integration & demo
phases.note: End-to-end test added (real aiohttp server + WebSocket client + tap -> taps.jsonl); the server/transport layer had no coverage before. Default board strategy switched from the ~30s LLM path to the student (measured 18ms), so the board now keeps up with a conversation. Remaining: a real run against the ESP32 wearable, and the console record button is still markup-only.
